context.transcript:
M
I'm honored to be leading the orientation for all our new
workers here at SalTech. I'll be distributing your ID badges,
which you'll need to access all the secure rooms in the
building. Then, I'll lead you on a tour. As we walk around,
notice how many employees have decorated their work
spaces. We encourage you to bring in family photos or
art-whatever would make you feel comfortable here. Oh,
and before I forget-and this isn't an official company
event-but a group of us are going to dinner tonight. We'll
be meeting in the lobby at five-thirty. Now, let's get started.
